THIS WEEK IN LOCAL GOVERNMENT

The Weston Village Board approved a $6.7 million contract to build a new Mountain Bay Metropolitan Police Department facility, and heard that DC Everest School District may bring an $81–94 million facilities referendum to voters in April 2027.

  • The Weston Village Board voted 7-0 to award the Mountain Bay Metro Police Department building contract to 8 Pine Inc. for $6.7 million, under the $7 million budget.
  • DC Everest school leaders presented long-range facility plans to the Weston board that could include an $81–94 million referendum in April 2027.
  • The Weston Finance and HR Committee recommended renewing a 36-month Cintas uniform agreement and extending the village's audit contract with Hawkins Ash through 2026.
  • The Kronenwetter Parks Committee recommended the village board approve a September 12 Bushka Park 5K/3K run-walk as an official village event and contribute a $5,000 matching grant toward a parks foundation fund.
  • Kronenwetter's Plan Commission is set to consider a zoning change for Marathon County Highway Department property and a conditional use permit for a residential pond on Happy Hollow Road.

Coming up: The Marathon County Board meets Tuesday, July 28, and the Kronenwetter Village Board holds its regular meeting Monday, July 27 — both expected to take up the Marathon County Highway Facility rezone and related land-use items. Wausau's Room Tax Commission and Bicycle & Pedestrian Advisory Committee also meet Monday.
